title: Flatness of the canonical ringed etale morphism
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the canonical enlarged etale ringed-site model and its equivalence to the small etale model [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. The canonical ringed etale morphism is flat when $\mathcal O_X$ is flat over $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Equivalently, take the inverse image $I$ on sheaves of rings as the left adjoint to the canonical ring direct image; let $\alpha:I\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ be the adjoint of the chart-normalized structural map. Scalar extension, the left adjoint to restriction of scalars along $\alpha$ on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], must be exact [def-galois-exact-functor]. These adjunction universal properties fix the inverse ring and scalar extension up to their adjunction-preserving natural isomorphisms.
